d: Anti-India hate is going viral and it is increasingly becoming a lucrative online business. From racist memes and anti-immigrant posts to AI-generated videos targeting Indians, inflammatory content is attracting millions of views across social media platforms. Meanwhile, India's coveted Big Tech dream is facing fresh uncertainty. Google and Microsoft are reportedly considering putting their 2027 campus hiring plans in India on hold, raising concerns for thousands of aspiring engineers.
